value.rationale: The exact unbounded additive and factor-two separation on a natural two-type square binary instance isolates a structural limit of comparing house allocation with unrestricted fair division, juxtaposing Wu 2026 continuous-random coincidence and Dai et al. 2026 singleton optimization. The precise invariant and gap matter for subsidy-budget models, not just a routine isolated integer case.
